title: Adventures of Trustworthy Vision-Language Models: A Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying existing literature that measures gender bias using metrics such as Grounded SEAT and WEAT, Association Scores, Leakage in Image Captioning (LIC), and VLStereoSet probing tasks.
Reviewing studies that quantify racial bias through metrics like Grounded SEAT and WEAT, Leakage in Image Captioning (LIC), ImageCaptioner2, and VLStereoSet.

Summarizing evaluations of societal and stereotypical biases using the CounterBias method, vision-language relevance/bias scores, and VLStereoSet to test model tendencies to recognize stereotypical statements.

Evaluating the structural modality bias where vision-language models disproportionately rely on the text modality over visual inputs, analyzed through cross-modality probing, zero-shot testing, and attention mapping.
